items.title: Jimmy Lewis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: I think one of these Bob Haggart books.

ctx.x: On ukulele. At the end of the year he says, “everybody keeps asking about a bass fiddle.” He said, “You don’t have one of these.” So I said uh oh, they’re going to get rid of me and get a bass. So what I did, I went down the next day to a place and got me a bass. I brought it home, didn’t know anything about it. Had it tuned, had a man in the store tune it up, and the first string, the G string, I could play everything on the G string. It’s one string, right here. And so I got my book, I think one of these Bob…
Well I think your ukulele playing must have helped.
